queries.name: GetRfcLifecycleProjection
queries.output: current accepted RFC source fields with exact evidence references, derived status_class/authority, current terminal epoch if any, local archive state, unresolved warnings
queries.rule: source evidence bodies/history are read through LLD-04; this query exposes accepted current ticket projection only

queries.name: GetPendingRfcTerminalCascade
queries.output: pending proposal identity/revision/terminal evidence/epoch, immutable captured RFC/WFM membership, scope fingerprint and restart-persistent state
queries.rule: executed/superseded history remains queryable through historical filter but is never returned as executable pending authority

queries.name: PreviewRfcTerminalCascade
queries.output: persisted captured scope versus freshly recomputed RFC/WFM scope, stale reasons, LLD-05 Task/Objective impact preview, LLD-09 Communication impact preview, deliberate-confirmation requirement
rules: no scope refresh or downstream mutation
INDETERMINATE participant preview fails closed for execution readiness

queries.name: PreviewRfcArchive
queries.output: exact member IDs/revisions/archive states, members that would change, already-archived excluded members, scope_fingerprint and lifecycle-neutral consequence summary
queries.rule: branch preview is explicit and bounded to current root plus direct subordinates

queries.name: GetRfcArchiveOperation
queries.output: immutable requested scope/fingerprint, members actually archived by the operation, latest per-member archive event and current restore eligibility
queries.rule: operation membership never implies that a member is still archived by that operation after later independent actions

queries.name: PreviewRfcHardDelete
queries.output: eligible boolean, exact RFC revision, typed blockers, per-domain determinate/indeterminate guard results, bounded provider freshness tokens and eligibility_fingerprint
rules: manual creation audit is classified separately from post-creation protected history
any source adoption/provenance, relationship/history/lifecycle/archive/correction dependency or INDETERMINATE provider makes eligible=false
command recomputes every guard and fingerprint inside the deletion UoW
